state.description: Build a new 4 - breaker 230kV ring bus at Rockville substation (no auto transformer to be added at this time). Loop in the Eatonton Primary #2 - Wallace Dam 230kV line. Build a new line 230kV line to Tiger Creek. Build a new 230kV line to North Spa.

q.instructions: Is this OpenStreetMap substation the endpoint the filing names?

criteria.true: Same facility: the name matches and the operator, voltage and state are consistent with the project.
